title: FauliPack
description: Just an HUD overhaul that's themed in the colors of Faulimon.
body:
🎨 FauliPack – The Faulimon HUD
Welcome to FauliPack! This resource pack was developed by the FloloreanerServer Team and gives your Minecraft HUD a completely fresh, stylish, and perfectly coordinated look.

The special twist? The entire design is inspired by Faulimon's official skin and captures its iconic split look! If you are looking for a clean, modern, and color-balanced UI, this pack is exactly what you need.

✨ Features at a Glance
❤️ Health Bar (Hearts): The classic hearts keep their vibrant red color but are outlined with a modern, very dark purple-blue. This creates a sleek and sharp contrast.

🍗 Hunger Bar (Drumsticks): Say goodbye to the default look! The hunger icons have been completely recolored and shine in a bright, icy cyan/light blue to match the blue half of the skin.

🎯 Custom Crosshair: A real eye-catcher in-game. The center features a single red pixel, surrounded by four cyan bars and diagonal red angles on the corners. It perfectly merges both main colors and ensures maximum precision during building and combat.

⚡ XP Bar: A dynamic color gradient that starts fiery red on the left, transitions through yellow and green in the middle, and ends in a cool cyan on the right. The level indicator is styled in a matching pastel red.

🧥 Inspired by the Skin
The color scheme is no accident: Just like the red and blue sides of the hoodie, the Yin-Yang symbol, and the different-colored eyes of the original Faulimon skin, this harmony of Fire & Ice is reflected in every single pixel of the HUD.

👥 Credits
Developer: Created and published by the FloloreanerServer Team.

What are you waiting for? Bring the Faulimon look straight to your screen!
